title: CI: ensure better-sqlite3 installs without local C++ build tools
description: Risk surfaced in cck.3 code review: better-sqlite3 compiled from source on the dev machine (prebuild-install deprecated; no prebuilt matched Node 24 ABI). Any CI/clean environment without an MSVC/node-gyp toolchain will fail npm install. Resolve by pinning/using a better-sqlite3 version that ships NAPI prebuilds for the target Node ABI, or provisioning build tools in CI. Not blocking E0 dev; required before reproducible CI.
acceptance_criteria: CI installs and tests better-sqlite3 without requiring local C++ build tools on the supported runner; failure mode and fallback/prebuild strategy are documented; npm test/build remains green in CI.
close_reason: CI workflow with prebuilt-binary better-sqlite3 strategy (Node 22 LTS pin) + documented failure mode & fallback; spec+quality reviewed (2 stages), claims network-verified, both gates pass

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Spec review: ✅ compliant — all 3 AC met; network claims independently verified (11.10.0: Node22/ABI v127 prebuilt = HTTP 200, Node24/ABI v137 = HTTP 404, reproducing the cck.3 failure mode). Code quality (d202292..e47f841): Ready to merge — no Critical/Important. Lockfile tracked at root so npm ci + setup-node cache safe; actions checkout@v4/setup-node@v4 current; build-from-source=false makes missing prebuilt fail loudly; persistence test genuinely exercises better-sqlite3. Minor/optional only: scope push to main, add job timeout-minutes, soften 'silently' wording — not blocking.
